verses.text: “Tell the Israelites to give you twelve staffs, one from the leader of each ancestral family. Write each leader’s name on his own staff.
Write Aaron’s name on Levi’s staff. There’s one staff for each head of an ancestral family.
Put them in the Tent of Meeting in front of the covenant, where I meet with you.
The staff of the man I choose will sprout. That’s how I’ll put an end to the Israelites’ complaints against you that keep reaching me.”
Moses told the Israelites, and their leaders gave him one staff for each ancestral family, twelve staffs in all. Aaron’s staff was among them.
Moses placed the staffs before Yahweh in the Tent of the Testimony.
The next day Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony, and there it was: Aaron’s staff for Levi’s family had sprouted, formed buds, opened flowers, and grown ripe almonds.
Moses took all the staffs from before Yahweh and brought them out to the Israelites. They looked at them, and each man took his own staff.
Yahweh told Moses, “Put Aaron’s staff back in front of the covenant. Keep it there as a warning to the rebels. Put an end to their complaints against me so they don’t die.”
Moses did exactly what Yahweh told him.
The Israelites told Moses, “Look at us! We’re dying! We’re ruined! Every one of us is ruined!
Anyone who gets close to Yahweh’s tabernacle dies! Are all of us going to die?”
